AUTHOR: Martins
TITLE: Temporal aggregation of vision-language features for high-accuracy fish classification in automated monitoring
REGION: Krossá, Laxá in Leirársveit and Selá rivers, Iceland
SPECIES: Brown/sea trout Salmo trutta, Arctic char Salvelinus alpinus, Atlantic salmon Salmo salar (+ not-fish)
DATA: MFRI Vaki Riverwatcher fish-counter videos, 3 rivers, 2018-2022 (9257 videos; 3990 used for species classification)
V_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'recorded in clear water conditions, with occasional instances of artifacts (e.g., minor biofouling, algae, and heavy turbulence)'; colour by day, infrared at night
D2: Species: video-level random 80/20 train/test x10 seeds with 5-fold CV; detection: 334/333 videos val/test
D_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'all dataset splits were performed at the video level'; 'This video-level partitioning eliminates the temporal correlation between the training and evaluation sets.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.3/2.4: all splits drawn from the same 3-river Riverwatcher dataset; Sec. 4.2.4: validation 'in controlled underwater environments ... may limit its generalization'
C_EV: Sec. 3.1.3: 'The threshold found, by maximizing the F1-score at the frame-level, resulted in the optimal value of ≈0.978.'
E_EV: Abstract/Table 4: '99.1% accuracy in fish detection, 98.2% accuracy in multiple fish detection, and 97.5% accuracy in species classification'
ARCH: Zero-shot SigLIP (ViT-SO400M-14) prompt-ensemble detection + multi-fish filter; SigLIP embeddings with temporal pooling + SVM/LR; ResNet-50 baselines
METR: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC, macro/weighted F1, confusion matrix, learning curves
NOTE: Riverwatcher fish counter (fishway/river counter) = field monitoring data. Rivers/years pooled in random video-level splits; no cross-river/year test -> R1=N. Zero-shot web-pretrained SigLIP applied to river footage could be read as 'off-the-shelf model outside training domain' (R1=Y, R3=N) under the final R rule; coded lower-information N. PRE: webli/LAION (no allowed value) -> NR. Fig. 9 reports correct/incorrect counts by confidence bin (informal, not coded as calibration). Videos with multiple fish or short segments excluded (data filtering, not coded C4).
AUTHORS_FULL: Martins, JRD; Bároarson, H; Guobrandsson, J; Einarsson, H
